title: Topic 17: Weather & Seasons - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Weather app format
WEATHER TODAY - CITY APP
Recife: Hot! Sun all day. Perfect for water!
Curitiba: Cold. Rain in the morning, strong wind at
night.
Gramado: Very cold! It is snowing in the mountains
right now.
THE WEEKEND: sun in all cities! It is spring - the
cold days go, the hot days come.
Open the app every morning!

TEXT B - Postcard format
Hi Vava!
I am writing this from Gramado - winter here! It is
very cold, and look: it is snowing NOW. My first snow!
Every morning we drink hot coffee, and at night we
watch films - it is our winter hobby.
And you, in Recife? Is it hot? Are you swimming
every day?
Kisses, Bibi

readingQuestions.question: What is this text?
options: A weather report for three cities
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: A weather report for three cities

readingQuestions.question: Where is it snowing right now?
Which city is good for swimming TODAY?
What is this text?
options: A postcard from Bibi's winter trip
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: A postcard from Bibi's winter trip

readingQuestions.question: What is happening in Gramado at the moment Bibi writes?
'Every morning we DRINK hot coffee' but 'it IS SNOWING now'. Why the two forms?
options: drink = every day (habit), is snowing = right now
is snowing = every day, drink = now
One of them is a mistake
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: drink = every day (habit), is snowing = right now
